title: Assessing Effectiveness of Adult Learning Programmes in Growth Sectors
what_it_is: Assessing Effectiveness of Adult Learning Programmes in Growth Sectors

sections.label: SkillsFuture and Work-Study outcomes
sections.summary: About 55% of unemployed SkillsFuture Career Transition trainees found jobs within six months, and Work-Study upgraders enjoyed wage premiums of around 6% to 11%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For example, as of December 2024, about 55% of almost 4,300 trainees who were unemployed at the start of the SkillsFuture Career Transition Programmes found new jobs within six months of course completion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Last year, the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) published findings from its Work-Study econometric study, showing that Institute of Technical Education (ITE) and polytechnic graduates who upgraded via Work-Study Programmes enjoyed wage premiums of around 6% to 11%, compared to those who transited straight into employment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The findings are generally positive, with more than 90% of trainees employed and enjoying higher median salaries, compared to at the start of the training.
